description: This file implements the QuicChromiumAlarmFactory and QuicChromeAlarm classes, which are used to create and manage alarms within the QUIC protocol implementation in Chromium. It includes methods for setting, canceling, and firing alarms, integrating with Chromium's task runner and timer infrastructure.

classes.name: QuicChromeAlarm
classes.description: A custom alarm class that integrates Chromium's timer with QUIC's alarm interface, using a task runner and clock.

methods.name: QuicChromiumAlarm
methods.description: Constructor initializing the alarm with clock, task runner, and delegate.

methods.name: SetImpl
methods.description: Sets the alarm timer based on the deadline and current clock.

methods.name: OnAlarm
methods.description: Callback invoked when the timer fires; checks clock and triggers the alarm.

methods.name: NowTicks
methods.description: Returns the current time in ticks, using the Chromium clock.
